name: Forget
overview: Scripture teaches that believers are called to forget the former things, including past sins and failures, because God has blotted out transgressions for His own sake and will not remember sins (Isaiah 43:18, 25). This forgetting is essential for living a new life in Christ, as one must not look back or cling to the past to be fit for the kingdom of God (Luke 9:62). Christians are empowered to walk according to the Spirit, not the flesh, embracing the life of faith given through Christ's sacrifice (Romans 8:1; Galatians 2:20). Furthermore, this divine forgiveness models how believers should forgive one another, reflecting God's kindness and tenderheartedness (Ephesians 4:32).
